environment: AWS M5d.metal and M6g.metal bare-metal hosts
Linux/KVM with sufficient CPU and memory
minimal guest and source-specific workload controls
claims: API startup wall time 6-60 ms, typically 12 ms
VMM overhead <= 5 MiB for 1 vCPU and 128 MiB after excluding guest mappings
guest boot <= 125 ms from InstanceStart to /sbin/init
full nonblocking metrics FIFO may lose output and increments missed_metrics_count
pending: network throughput and latency integration coverage

environment: AWS M5d.metal host in a VPC
Amazon Linux 2 host and guest with Linux kernel 4.14
ping, 10 Mbps background traffic, and multiple iperf3 clients
pending: SPECIFICATION.md retains network performance integration coverage as pending

measurements.name: process_startup_wall_us
measurements.interpretation: signed process startup wall clock before retained guest work

measurements.name: process_startup_cpu_us
measurements.interpretation: signed process startup CPU clock before retained guest work

measurements.name: whole_process_rss_kib
measurements.producer: /bin/ps -o rss= -p PID at the guest ready barrier
measurements.interpretation: whole Bangbang process including guest mappings

measurements.name: guest_init_wall_us
measurements.interpretation: InstanceStart to checked guest boot-timer write

measurements.name: guest_init_cpu_us
measurements.interpretation: process CPU consumed through the checked guest boot-timer write

measurements.name: guest_compute_duration_ns
measurements.interpretation: fixed data-dependent loop guest clock, not CoreMark or bare-metal ratio

measurements.name: guest_storage_duration_ns
measurements.interpretation: fixed sequential read guest clock, not fio or uncached throughput

measurements.name: metrics_fifo_filled_bytes
measurements.interpretation: host pipe capacity observation, not loss evidence alone

measurements.name: metrics_fifo_drained_bytes
measurements.interpretation: sentinel and possible partial failed-publication bytes

measurements.name: metrics_missed_count
measurements.producer: logger.missed_metrics_count after one typed failure and retry

policy.platform: Apple Silicon macOS with executable Hypervisor.framework; no unsupported bypass
sessions: independent signed workload session per warmup and iteration
independent signed real metrics FIFO session per warmup and iteration
policy.comparison_key: SHA-256 of environment, policy, ordered metric definitions, and optional fixture identity; raw values and summaries excluded
policy.publication: canonical mode-0600 absent-only report after complete root-session cleanup
policy.network_fixture: explicit credential-free no-shell bounded fixture with digest-pinned executable, matching labels, integer output, cleanup=complete, and no argv/environment in report
policy.ci: portable schema, parser, fake transaction, real portable FIFO, fixture, cleanup, publication, and static audit only; no hardware threshold
policy.merged_main_gate: fresh ignored networkless report from clean synchronized merged main with matching commit/tree/binary identity
